question: Which of the following mountain ranges contains the 'Valley of Flowers' National Park?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**West Himalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Valley of Flowers National Park** is located in the **West Himalaya region** in the state of **Uttarakhand, India**.
 
• It is renowned for its **stunning meadows of endemic alpine flowers** and is a part of the **Nanda Devi Biosphere Reserve**.
 
• The Valley of Flowers is situated at an altitude ranging between **3,200 meters to 6,675 meters** above sea level.
 
• It is a UNESCO **World Heritage Site** and is known for its **extraordinary biodiversity**, including rare and endangered species of flora and fauna.
 
• This park is home to several medicinal plants such as **Aconitum heterophyllum** and **Dactylorhiza hatagirea**.
 
• It is also famous for its association with Indian mythology, believed to be the place where **Hanuman** found the 'Sanjeevani Booti' to revive Lakshman.
 
• The park is a popular destination for **trekkers and nature enthusiasts**, and the route to the Valley of Flowers passes through **Ghangaria village**.
 
• It was discovered in **1931** by British mountaineers **Frank S. Smythe** and **R. L. Holdsworth**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dhauladhar**__

 __
 
• The **Dhauladhar range** is a part of the **Lesser Himalayas** located in Himachal Pradesh, India.
 
• It is known for its **steep slopes** and is a popular destination for **trekking and mountaineering**.
 
• Places like **Triund** and **Mcleodganj** are situated near this range.
 
 
 
• **Pir Panjal**__
 __
 
• The **Pir Panjal range** is the largest range of the **Lesser Himalayas** and is located in Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand.
 
• It is famous for the **Banihal Pass** and the **Jawahar Tunnel**, which connect Jammu to the Kashmir Valley.
 
 
 
• **Karakoram**__
 
 
• The **Karakoram range** is located in the northernmost part of India and spans the borders of **India, Pakistan, and China**.
 
• It is home to **K2**, the second-highest peak in the world, and the **Siachen Glacier**, the highest battleground on Earth.
